description: Code Llama is Meta's family of code-specialized large language models built on Llama 2. Available in 7B, 13B, 34B, and 70B sizes with variants for general code, Python specialization, and instruction-following.

contextLength.7B-34B: 16K tokens (up to 100K with long context fine-tuning)

trainingData.description: Built on Llama 2 with additional training on code-focused data. 7B-34B trained January-July 2023, 70B trained January 2023-January 2024.

trainingProcedure: Continued pretraining from Llama 2 on code data. Python variants have additional Python-specific training. Instruct variants have instruction tuning.

evaluation.performanceSummary: State-of-the-art open code model at release. Strong performance on HumanEval and code completion benchmarks.

benchmarks.note: Benchmarks vary by model size. 34B models generally outperform smaller variants.

knownLimitations: 70B variant limited to 16K context (no long context support)
May generate code with bugs or security vulnerabilities
Python variant optimized for Python, less effective for other languages
Based on Llama 2 (older architecture than Llama 3)

ethicalConsiderations.biasAndFairness: May reflect biases in code training data.
ethicalConsiderations.safetyMeasures: Instruct variants have safety tuning. Code should always be reviewed before use.
ethicalConsiderations.privacyConsiderations: Open weights allow local deployment for privacy-sensitive code.

licenseTerms: Separate license required for >700M monthly active users
Cannot use outputs to improve other LLMs (except Llama derivatives)

hardware.70B: Multi-GPU required, ~140GB VRAM for full precision
